faqs.q: Can you advertise Botox® and fillers on Meta?
faqs.a: Yes, within the rules. Meta restricts ads that promote prescription drugs, so we build campaigns around consultations, skin concerns and results rather than the product itself.

Usually higher-value treatments and packages, such as skin boosters, laser, body contouring and filler packages, because the return per patient justifies the ad spend. We'll recommend a lead offer for your clinic on the call.
